findings: Both power blocks expose bottom, bottom/r90, bottom/r180 and bottom/r270. The new offers are evaluated, not merely catalogued.
Expanding power_som side eligibility loses the successful reference search path even though its old top offers remain. This is search incompleteness, not evidence of geometric impossibility.

The first power_som bottom choice at 163x153 has a lower estimator score than the control's first top choice, but fails downstream. The lower local estimate does not establish global packing feasibility.

Observed failed stages include interior seating (usb_jtag, usb_pd) and legalization. A reported USB-JTAG/HDMI cycle combines HDMI-to-SoM proximity with a chosen separation direction; it does not establish an electrical relationship between USB-JTAG and HDMI.
next_algorithm_work: Add and test failure-directed reconsideration of early shape/side choices, with invocation-local snapshots, explicit execution accounting and accepted-incumbent retention. Do not hardcode power_som top or treat this failed screen as proof that bottom power is unsafe.
limitations: Diagnostic single runs, not performance comparisons or full qualification. No smaller accepted layout. No default/spec changes adopted. All failed work remains in logs; no gates waived. Historical Python comparison remains outstanding.
